How it is made

Drawn from docs/changes.md, each journey's Status history and the prototype's proofs. List the date each update starts in project.md, oldest first: updates: [YYYY-MM-DD, …]. The last is the current Update; each earlier one keeps its own page. Without dates there is one, covering everything. Print it with one slide per page and choose Save as PDF; npm run share puts it in the folder you send. Also generated: pitch, stakeholder deck. Choose the decks in project.md: presentation: [pitch, stakeholders, update].
